text:
maria_cs: AcroHealth (org_acro_987) onboarding blocked — EU region not enabled + current rate limits too low for demo next Mon 08:00 CET. Can we enable eu-west, add these IPs to allowlist, and temporarily bump their rate to 50 requests/min (org-level) for 72h? Renewal flagged if demo fails. IPs: `34.120.12.5/32, 34.120.12.6/32`. Also they need model routing to prefer `redwood/long-context-2x` for demo. @jason_se assigning.
jason_se: Got it. What's the org_id and the project/route name? Need to check model availability in EU and whether that model is compatible with private instances.
maria_cs: org_acro_987, project: `acro-dashboard-prod`, route: `generate-chat`. Customer will only use hosted API. No VPC peering. They asked for EU processing due to data residency.
karen_pm: Heads-up on renewal risk — if we can't guarantee demo performance, CSM -> renewal may slip. Any cost impact on billing for the temporary bump? If so we should loop in finance.
leo_infra: I can enable region and bump rate but need ticket with approvers + planned rollback window. Also need the IP CIDRs in a single line and confirmation there's no nested subnets. We'll run canary on two pods before full switch.
maria_cs: Approver: Karen M (Account exec) OK'd. Rollback 72h after start. IPs are the two above, single line. Demo start Mon 08:00 CET; prefer change at 07:30 CET for warm-up.
infra-bot: Created ticket: INF-2026-8872 — EU region enable + org rate bump + allowlist add. Assigning to eng-infra oncall.
eng-infra-oncall: INF-2026-8872 accepted. We'll do canary 07:20 CET Mon, full rollout 07:40 CET. Noting model `redwood/long-context-2x` availability in eu-west: currently replicated, ok.
infra-bot: INF-2026-8872 update: eu-west enabled for org_acro_987, allowlist entries applied, temporary rate limit increased to 50 rpm (org level) starting 1768560000 and ending 1768819200. Canary logs: https://redwood.ops/infra/INF-2026-8872/logs
maria_cs: :party_parrot: Awesome, will confirm with AcroHealth and schedule demo. Karen, can you advise on notifying finance for prorated charge?
karen_pm: I'll ping finance. Also logging renewal risk in Salesforce (oppty 012345) and adding note about demo success being a gating factor.
maria_cs: Customer updated: they see latency drop in EU, demo confirmed for Mon 08:00 CET. Thanks team — closing thread after post-demo check.
eng-oncall: Reminder: auto-rollback scheduled at 1768819200 (72h). I'll watch metrics and escalate if errors >5%.
